info.description: Curated land, residential, and commercial listings shown on the Properties page.

priceGuide.description: Indicative starting price in millions (NGN), for discovery only — not a binding quote

features.description: Array of short feature strings, e.g. ["Gated estate", "C of O", "24/7 power"]

gallery.description: Additional photos shown on the property detail page, beyond the main image

size.description: Land size or floor area, e.g. "300sqm" — optional, since not every listing (e.g. a general category conversation-starter) has one specific size

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms, where applicable (not used for land)

documentationStatus.description: Title/documentation trust marker, e.g. "FCDA Approved · Right of Occupancy (RofO)"

paymentInfo.description: Payment plan / terms summary shown on the property detail page

project.description: Optional link if this property belongs to a specific development
